fusions.name: Spellstorm Bead
fusions.desc: Hurls a bead of raw arcana on a gust that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, dealing 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Eddy of Sparks
fusions.desc: Spins an eddy of sparking air around you, which deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Clear the Ley
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you, and you move 15% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Breath of Power
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, you regain 4 stamina. Once every 3 seconds.
